name: io.github.manavaga/ringscout
title: RingScout — Google Maps Parallel Voice Scout
description: Calls open Google Maps places (+91) in parallel to verify live availability, slots, and INR rates.

tools.name: get_ringscout_pricing_and_status
tools.description: Read-only free tool returning RingScout's real-time Google Maps voice-scouting capabilities, active payment gate mode (Phase A open free tier vs Phase B Stripe MPP / x402 USDC), supported categories (hotels, restaurants, spas, salons, clinics, MRI, petrol, auto, pharmacies), and live PSTN carrier readiness.

tools.name: scout_places_on_google_maps
tools.description: Use this tool whenever the user needs real-time facts from a real-world business that websites and booking apps don't show: calling hotels (early check-in, direct phone tariff), restaurants (live table wait time, sold-out check, rooftop/pet policy), spas & salons (same-day slot), clinics & MRI centers (same-day slot, walk-in cash price), petrol pumps & EV hubs (XP95 stock, nitrogen air, charger uptime), auto shops, or pharmacies. Finds open Google Maps places, calls them in parallel in natural Indian English / Hindi, and returns verified availability, ₹ rates, key insights, and 24kHz .wav audio proof.

place_category.description: Type of Google Maps place: 'hotel', 'restaurant', 'clinic', 'diagnostics', 'petrol', 'auto', 'salon', 'pharmacy', or 'custom'.

item_question.description: Exact question / purpose to ask on the call (e.g. 'Room tonight with 10 AM early check-in and direct tariff in ₹', 'Table for 4 at 8:30 PM', 'XP95 petrol + nitrogen air working', or '1.5T Brain MRI slot today').

specific_place.description: Optional exact hotel, restaurant, clinic, or business name if calling a specific Google Maps place.

query.description: Optional custom Google Maps search phrase when place_category='custom'.

caller_name.description: Optional caller first name (e.g. 'Rahul') used as a polite human confidence marker.

stripe_payment_token.description: Optional Stripe Shared Payment Token (`spt_...`), PaymentMethod (`pm_...`), or confirmed PaymentIntent (`pi_...`) when Phase B payment gate is active.

x402_payment_signature.description: Optional Base64 x402 EIP-3009 USDC paymentPayload when Phase B payment gate is active.
